caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average accuracy (described in the caption as averaged across 11 datasets) for a set of training methods, with one bar per method. The category axis is the horizontal x-axis, showing five labeled methods in left-to-right order: “Standard,” “Self-RAG,” “FactTune,” “ClnGS (w/),” and “ClnGS.” The value axis is the vertical y-axis labeled “Average Performance,” using a linear scale with tick marks at regular 10-unit intervals (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60) and an upper plotting limit slightly above 60. The “Standard” bar is orange and reaches a little above 50 (approximately 52–53), “Self-RAG” is a light khaki/olive color at roughly the mid-50s (about 54), “FactTune” is yellow-green and sits a bit above 50 (around 51–52), “ClnGS (w/)” is steel-blue and is also in the mid-50s (about 53–54), and “ClnGS” is dark blue and is the tallest, reaching just under 60 (approximately 59–60). The bars are presented as a single series (not grouped or stacked), appear in the stated categorical order rather than being sorted by height, and none are visually emphasized with special outlines, annotations, or patterns beyond distinct fill colors.
